title: monogramma robusta
intro: Monogramma robusta, commonly known as the rock cap fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, which may help in protecting the body from oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Monogramma robusta include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may aid in wound healing and skin protection. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to confirm their specific roles and effects.
